object: The universal six-variable homogeneous quartic shape P in K231's S6-projected K185/K218 signed rational-cosh core, not its coefficient A or its full integrand
centered_identity: With y_i=x_i-(sum_j x_j)/6, p_r=sum_i y_i^r, P=(7 p_2^2-10 p_4)/8. It follows by expanding m22,m211,m1111 at sum_i y_i=0 and Newton's fourth elementary-symmetric identity, together with the translation invariance evident from the SOS.
zero_set: P>=0 and P=0 exactly when at least five of the six coordinates agree. If every disjoint pair of unequal-coordinate edges is absent, choose an unequal pair a,b. The other four vertices must share a value t; otherwise their unequal edge is disjoint from a,b. If both a and b differed from t, their edges to two distinct remaining vertices would be disjoint. Thus at most one exceptional coordinate remains. The converse follows termwise.
local_spread_bound: If Delta=max_i x_i-min_i x_i, then 0<=P<=45 Delta^4/12=15 Delta^4/4 by the 45 nonnegative square products. This is a deliberately loose bound on the quartic shape, not on the full rational core.
finite_coefficient_control: At K231's exact u=5/4,v=17/8,b=1, A is positive because the two-coordinate fourth coefficient equals A*P(1,1,0,0,0,0)=A>0. The three-coordinate coefficient equals (3/2)A. Neither control establishes the sign of A at other positive u,v,b.
claim_ceiling: Exact universal SOS, nonnegativity, zero set and translation invariance of K231's quartic shape, plus an inherited finite positive coefficient at one point. No global sign for A, uniform fifth-order remainder, complete projected rational integrand sign, third-shell integral/cost, K215, boundary composition, source/physics/ledger/canon change.
